pages.text: Aquaculture fills the water with fish that keep to their own biomes.

Rods take a hook, bait, line and bobber, and the better metals last longer. A fillet knife turns a catch into something cookable. Fish long enough and the sea may give up a Neptune's Bounty.$(br2)$(l:food/tide)Tide$(/l) works alongside it. Use whichever rod you like.
